title: Limiting Law of Local Fields for the Mean Field Ghatak-Sherrington Model
summary: We study the limiting law of local field in the mean field Ghatak-Sherrington model with spin values $\{0,\pm1,\ldots,\pm S\}$ in the high-temperature regime. Using the cavity method and the quantitative overlap and self-overlap estimates of Sheng-Wu~\cite{SW24}, we prove a central limit theorem for the non-centered cavity field. As a result, we then identify the local field limiting law as a random finite mixture of Gaussian distributions. The proof is based on moment method and gives a quantitative error bound.
